name: Channel launch
headline: TikTok Shop category opened — fit evaluation

criteria.label: Breakeven month
criteria.note: cumulative contribution margin covers launch spend

criteria.label: Run-rate GMV at M6
criteria.note: the ramp matters more than the annual total

criteria.label: Blended CAC
criteria.note: paid, creator fees and sampling included

criteria.label: New-buyer share
criteria.note: the whole audience argument rests on this

criteria.label: Existing-channel impact
criteria.note: cannibalisation ceiling on Shopify and Amazon

rationale.label: Audience we cannot reach today
rationale.note: 68% of category buyers on the platform are under 35; that cohort is 24% of our base.

rationale.label: Discovery mechanics we have no equivalent of
rationale.note: Product discovery happens in feed, not in search. Our SEO and Amazon strength does not transfer.

rationale.label: Category opened with low competitive density
rationale.note: Eleven sellers in the subcategory today. That advantage has a short shelf life.

rationale.label: Against: content operating cost is permanent
rationale.note: The channel needs 12–16 new videos a month forever. Nothing about that gets cheaper at scale.

risk.label: Maximum exposure
risk.note: hard cap across integration, creative and inventory

risk.label: Integration spend cap
risk.note: existing connector only, no custom middleware

risk.label: Creative and creator budget
risk.note: first 90 days, costed as a line item not an afterthought

risk.label: Inventory at risk
risk.note: units committed that cannot be sold elsewhere at full price

risk.label: Decision reversibility
risk.note: wind-down path must be defined before approval

locked.label: MAP posture
locked.detail: No price below MAP on any channel, whatever the platform’s promotional calendar pushes. Platform-funded discounts are acceptable; ours are not.

locked.label: Content control
locked.detail: Brand-owned creative is approved before it runs. Creator content carries no product claim we have not signed off, and no claim about competitors at all.

locked.label: Integration capacity
locked.detail: One engineer-month available in Q4. The channel runs on the existing connector and the existing catalogue mapping, or it waits.

locked.label: Written rationale either way
locked.detail: Go, pilot or no-go, the reasoning is filed as a Ledger asset with the numbers it was based on, so the next person to ask can read the answer.

chips.label: MAP floor holds on all channels

trigger.what: The platform opened Home & Kitchen to new sellers in our region, with the category fee schedule published.
Prospector scored audience overlap against our buyer base and flagged the under-35 gap as the largest unaddressed segment.
Navigator opened a business case and pinned the card. Onboarding incentives expire Sep 26, which is what makes this a dated decision.

agents.name: Prospector
agents.role: Audience overlap, competitive density and CAC estimates.

agents.name: Navigator
agents.role: Owns the business case and the 90-day gate.

agents.name: Merchandiser
agents.role: Assortment, listing content and per-unit economics.

agents.name: Planner
agents.role: Inventory positioning and the units committed to the pilot.

agents.name: Channel Fit Score
agents.role: Five-axis fit model, calibrated on our four live channels.

agents.name: Business Case Model
agents.role: P&L ramp with P10 / P50 / P90 and launch costs.
